text:
ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens: curly-edged light green lettuce leaves and darker reddish-purple leaves, with a large smooth bright green leaf in the center, piled loosely in a mound covering roughly 35% of a square white plate, about 15 cm across and 4 cm tall, matte with slight moisture on the leaves | 110
ITEM 2 | Thin bright green stalks, cut into segments about 8-12 cm long and roughly 0.3 cm thick, lying straight and loosely side by side in a fan shape on the right side of the plate, covering about 15% of the plate, crisp-looking, slightly glossy, not piled, about 1 cm tall | 35
ITEM 3 | Small cherry tomato halves, bright red with visible seeds, scattered among the greens near the center-right, each about 1.5-2 cm across, glossy and moist, roughly 2% of plate area | 10
ITEM 4 | Thin pieces of reddish-brown cooked meat or bacon-like strips, dark edges, slightly glossy, scattered in small pieces about 1-2 cm among the greens, covering about 4% of the plate | 12
ITEM 5 | Small orange-red shreds of carrot or pepper, thin and dispersed, sitting on top of and between the lettuce leaves, under 1% of plate area, slightly moist | 2
